name: editor.stitch
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Final-stage editor. Stitches N scene video clips with crossfades, mixes the per-scene voiceover tracks with a BGM track (with sidechain-style ducking under the voice), and writes the final MP4. The director.cinematic agent calls this once per dispatch as the packager step.

scenes_manifest.description: Absolute path to the scenes.json produced by scene-decomposer

scene_video_dir.description: Directory containing the per-scene video clips. Files are matched by basename from the manifest's deliverable_refs.video field.

scene_voice_dir.description: Directory containing per-scene voiceover WAVs. Files matched by deliverable_refs.voiceover basename.

bgm_file.description: Optional absolute path to a BGM track. If supplied, it's mixed under the voiceover at the volume_bgm_db level.

volume_voice_db.description: dB offset for the voiceover track (0 = unity)

volume_bgm_db.description: dB offset for the BGM track (default -12dB to sit under the voice)

crossfade_s.description: Crossfade duration between scenes in seconds

output.description: Absolute path for the final MP4. Defaults to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/<project>/<project>-final.mp4

file.description: Absolute path to the final MP4

duration_s.description: Total runtime of the assembled video

command.description: The ffmpeg command that was run

primary.name: ffmpeg
primary.notes: Local ffmpeg does the full job: concat with xfade filter, audio mix with volume controls.

fallbacks.name: ffmpeg-concat-no-transitions
fallbacks.notes: If the xfade filter fails (very old ffmpeg), fall back to a plain concat (no crossfades).

fallbacks.name: local-placeholder-text
fallbacks.notes: Last-ditch: write a placeholder text file at the output path so the contract is still satisfied (the engine will see it as an invalid mp4 and flag it in the audit log).
